setup: Same frozen frames on both renderers in an emulated iPhone: 844×390 landscape, DPR 3, touch, iPhone Safari user agent (so phone memory caps apply), LOW resolution (0.5) by default and MED 0.75 + UPSCALE where marked. TLX runs three's WebGL2 path, which is what an iPhone runs. Software-rendered stills and memory; frame time from the one real GPU we can reach (the CI Mac, with phone caps forced).
